{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders with '999999.99'
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Clean all revenue values: remove commas and cast to float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
df_clean['customer_age'] = df_clean['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Drop refunded orders — they are not completed sales
# The question is about campaign success, which is measured by completed orders that converted
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment (completed orders only):")
print(pd.crosstab(df_final['channel'], df_final['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rate by channel
converted_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(converted_by_channel)

# Compute conversion rate by segment and channel
conversion_by_segment_channel = df_final.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by segment and channel:")
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)

# Compute difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) within each segment
pivot = conversion_by_segment_channel.unstack('channel')
diff = pivot['email'] - pivot['paid_search']
print("\nDifference (email - paid_search) in conversion rate by segment:")
print(diff)

# Final dataset shape
print(f"\nFinal dataset shape: {df_final.shape}")"}
